note: How a MANUFACTURER says it publishes dimensions, stated once for the whole brand rather than re-argued per bag. A brand that answers 'do the listed dimensions include wheels and handles?' in its FAQ has settled the question for every product it sells, and re-deriving that from each product page is how one answer turns into forty judgement calls. Applied by data/build-bags.mjs, and ONLY to a figure we can confirm is the overall one — see the safety rule there.

Travelpro.quote: We publish both numbers. The case dimensions (the packing body only) are 19 x 15 x 7.75 in. The overall dimensions, which include wheels and carry handles, are 21.75 x 15.75 x 7.75 in. When airlines publish size limits they mean the overall size, so compare the overall number to your airline's limit.
Travelpro.source: Travelpro FAQ, 'Do the listed dimensions include wheels and handles?'
